The 2002 Italian Grand Prix (round 15, held at Autodromo Nazionale di Monza on 15 September 2002) was won by Rubens Barrichello driving for Ferrari. He started from fourth on the grid. Michael Schumacher finished second for Ferrari, and Eddie Irvine was third for Jaguar.

ANSWER: Rubens Barrichello
